reason: Docs describe a local ClusterFuzz instance (butler.py run_server --bootstrap) that runs on CPU with local emulators and no credentials.
goal: Get the local ClusterFuzz web server running as described in docs/getting-started/local_instance.md, using `python butler.py run_server --bootstrap` (install the prerequisites the docs list; local emulators, no cloud credentials). The web interface must be listening on http://localhost:9000 and serve pages, and the bootstrap must populate the local datastore. Provide /work/env.sh (environment setup) and /work/run.sh (starts the server in background and returns only once it is ready).
check: The hidden test starts the server via run.sh, verifies http://localhost:9000/ returns a ClusterFuzz page, and that the Fuzzers page lists the default fuzzers created by --bootstrap.

revision.by: fairness review (every maintained-set exam re-checked against the source)
issues: Oracle (and check text) require GET /login == 200, but login.Handler.get is decorated @handler.unsupported_on_local_server, which returns HTTP 400 on the local dev server by design; a correct install that follows local_instance.md cannot pass.

The recorded pass came only from the probe agent deleting that decorator from repo source (repo_diff: src/appengine/handlers/login.py, 1 line removed); the test rewarded a source patch, not the documented setup.
Coverage was thin: only '/' and '/login' HTML; nothing verified that the --bootstrap datastore seeding (what makes the local instance usable) worked.
evidence: src/appengine/libs/handler.py:147-160 - raises EarlyExitError('This feature is not available in local App Engine Development environment.', 400)
data/runs/google-clusterfuzz/result.json repo_diff - src/appengine/handlers/login.py removed 1 line; deliverables/setup.sh step 5 strips the decorator
src/local/butler/run_server.py:28-42 - --bootstrap runs 'butler.py run setup --non-dry-run --local' in a thread after 10 s
src/local/butler/scripts/setup.py:332-358 - creates afl, libFuzzer, honggfuzz, googlefuzztest, centipede Fuzzer entities
src/appengine/handlers/fuzzers.py:50-78 + src/appengine/templates/fuzzers.html:51 + src/appengine/handlers/base_handler.py:93-96 - /fuzzers embeds the fuzzer list as base64 JSON
src/appengine/libs/auth.py:64,160-162 - local development user is user@localhost and admin
